title: US-backed Board of Peace unveils $2.5-B Gaza recovery plan
summary: US President Donald Trump's Board of Peace proposed a $2.45 billion Gaza recovery plan on Wednesday at a meeting of its members and stakeholders, in an effort meant to span over six months.
